# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 11 Quarry widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger
# level-1..level-10 hybrid chassis baseline
# (tests/sd13_ranger_level10_progression.rs, the SD13 tranche's declared
# ceiling) to Ranger level 11 as chosen input only. It names selections; it
# does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It is the level-10
# baseline fixture with the class level bumped and exactly one additional
# chosen selection, exercising the 11th-level "Special" column entry, Quarry
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror: "At 11th level, a ranger can select one target within
# line of sight as his quarry... the ranger receives a +2 insight bonus on
# attack rolls made against his quarry, and he confirms all critical threats
# against the quarry automatically"):
#
#   choice=choice:ranger_quarry_target:enemy:humanoid_orc
#     -- the target designated as this ranger's quarry, mirroring the
#        Favored Enemy/Favored Terrain open-ended choice-recognition idiom
#        exactly (raw string interpolation, no restricted-list validation);
#        PF1 restricts the quarry to a target corresponding to one of the
#        ranger's own favored-enemy types, so this fixture names the same
#        enemy identifier already chosen as the first favored enemy
#        (enemy:humanoid_orc), though no favored-enemy-type matching is
#        implemented anywhere in this codebase to enforce that restriction
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-10 baseline fixture unchanged.
# No Survival-check-execution engine, no critical-confirmation-roll engine,
# and no active-quarry cooldown state (the 24-hour reselection cooldown or
# the 1-hour post-kill cooldown) exists in this codebase, so the fixture
# makes no such claim; only the grant identity and the flat +2 attack-roll
# magnitude are grounded.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level11-sd18-quarry
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:11
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2:feat:manyshot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_3:feat:shot_on_the_run
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
choice=choice:ranger_quarry_target:enemy:humanoid_orc
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
